club: Caldecote FC — The Pavilion, Harvey Close, Upper Caldecote
notes: The club line's version of record. The base system's version lives in app/package.json and is NOT touched here, so that merging a base release forward never lands on a version conflict. release-caldecote.yml checks the number below against the version it is asked to publish.
whyThisCut: 0.0.2 could show the club, but only if somebody typed four commands on the Pi after flashing it. A card is flashed, carried to a building and switched on by a volunteer with no keyboard, so in practice 0.0.2's image came up as a playlist player with Caldecote's name on the box — the same fault as 0.0.1 one step further out, and again invisible in a screenshot because the page answers 200 and looks deliberate. 0.0.3 puts the club's content on the card before its first boot: deploy/club-content.sh (base code, #46 on main) copies caldecote/card/* into the data directory and merges caldecote/card.env into the kiosk's environment, and .pitchtribe-club at the top of the checkout is how the installer and the image build know this is a club line at all. Flashing 0.0.3 is the whole job. 0.0.1 and 0.0.2 are superseded and should not be flashed; both are left published rather than deleted.
baseNote: This cut moved the base pointer: main @ 1d9ec6f (v0.4.2 +38) -> main @ 7e5f125 (v0.4.2 +41), merged forward on 16 November 2026. It brings #44 (bootstrap.sh commit-checks a club-line tag — it tested for a 'v' prefix, so caldecote-* tags, which is exactly what goes on a card in a pavilion, skipped the check silently) #46 (the club-content mechanism this release depends on, plus two base-wide fixes: kiosk.sh derived its health URL by cutting the page URL at /player, so any card pointed elsewhere waited its full minute on every boot, and the CI deploy-script check now finds scripts rather than naming eight by hand), and #48 (the image build now runs when a club line's card content changes — image/build.sh copies the club directory into the image, but none of those paths were under image/ or deploy/, so a pull request that renamed a club file or dropped the marker got every other check green and never built the one artefact that goes to the building). The merge forward conflicted once, in .github/workflows/app.yml, on comment wording only — both lines had written the same find; the base system's wording won. Earlier history: 0.0.1 was tagged at main @ e59050a (v0.4.2 +30); 0.0.2 stood on main @ 1d9ec6f and was 0.0.1 plus the club fix in #43; the line itself was cut at main @ 9bdcbba (v0.4.2 +25) and took #35 and #38 directly, before each landed on main.
